_note: The demo's voice-over, one file per line. Change a line's text and run `python -m scripts.demo_cut` to regenerate that file and rebuild the cut. Voices are synthetic (edge-tts).

lines.site_1: This is MCPL, Modern Colours, in Ludhiana.
lines.site_2: We also tested in a textile clothing factory.
lines.site_3: Most of what a job really takes is in the head of one expert.
lines.site_4: When that person is away, the next worker is on their own.
lines.site_5: Ustad captures that expert once, then guides anyone through the job, and checks the work.
lines.check_1: When a worker says done, SAM 3.1 finds the part in the frame.
lines.check_2: Muse Spark then has to choose one of three tools: pass the step, flag an error, or ask for a better view.
lines.check_3: A safety step can't be skipped by guessing.
lines.check_4: Every check saves its photo in an evidence pack.
lines.hindi_1: A worker can do the whole job in Hindi.
lines.hindi_2: Only the words change. The check stays the same, and numbers in a translation are verified in code.
lines.glimmer_1: Live guiding stays on the fast models.
lines.glimmer_2: On 8 test cases, 4 of them deliberately wrong, Muse Spark got 8 of 8 at a 4.6 second median, and Muse Glimmer also got 8 of 8, at 63 seconds.
lines.glimmer_3: So Glimmer is the second opinion after the job, for the doubtful steps.
lines.data_1: And every job makes labelled data: what was asked, what the camera saw, what was right.
lines.rl_1: From one 42 second clip we already built 1,046 labelled training examples, for reinforcement learning on Muse Glimmer. Training hasn't run yet. This is how the models keep getting better with every job.
lines.close_1: In our test runs, about 7 seconds from finishing a step to the next instruction.
lines.close_2: About 10 cents for a four-step job.
lines.close_3: Starting with India, a huge market.
lines.close_4: Ustad: captures your best expert, and checks every step.
lines.catch_1: Here is what it does when the work is wrong. In this test run the worker said done, but the bottle was still on the table.
lines.catch_2: Ustad refused the step, said why, and only passed it once the bottle was really in the air. Every attempt is on the record.
